description: Austria Insolvency & Court Publications Scraper. Scrape Austrian insolvency data from the Ediktsdatei - bankruptcies, reorganizations, debt settlements, court auctions, and Firmenbuch announcements. Official court publications with no API alternative. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

court.description: Filter by court name (e.g. 'Handelsgericht Wien', 'Landesgericht Linz'). Leave empty for all courts. | Nach Gericht filtern. Leer lassen fur alle Gerichte.
court.title: Court

dateFrom.description: Only return edicts published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Setting it is strongly recommended: it is the only filter the register applies server-side, so it is what keeps a browse-style run short, and it removes the need for the GmbH fallback query - without it a run with no searchQuery returns ONLY debtors whose name contains 'GmbH'. | Nur Veroeffentlichungen ab diesem Datum.
dateFrom.title: Published Since (Date From)

dateTo.description: Only return edicts published up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Applied per edict, not by the register, so a narrow window costs one page fetch per candidate. | Nur Veroeffentlichungen bis zu diesem Datum.
dateTo.title: Published Until (Date To)

entryType.description: Filter by entry type: 'initial' for new proceedings, 'changes' for updates, 'all' for both. | Ersteintrage, Anderungen, oder beides.
entryType.title: Entry Type

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matching records to return. Default: 100. Set to 0 for unlimited. This caps matches, not work: dateTo and proceedingType are checked per edict, so reaching the cap can require many more page fetches than the cap itself. | Maximale Anzahl der Ergebnisse.
maxResults.title: Max Results

proceedingType.description: Type of insolvency proceeding to filter. 'all' returns all types. | Art des Insolvenzverfahrens. 'all' gibt alle Verfahrensarten zuruck.
proceedingType.title: Proceeding Type

searchQuery.description: Name of the debtor or company to search for (minimum 3 characters). Partial match supported. | Name des Schuldners oder Unternehmens (mindestens 3 Zeichen).
searchQuery.title: Debtor / Company Name

state.description: Filter by Austrian federal state. | Nach Bundesland filtern.
state.title: Federal State (Bundesland)

name: regdata_austria_ediktsdatei
